changelog: - **Tenant isolation enforcement is now wired to the deploy path, and enforced in every topic environment** (#2356, epic #2349). `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` was never passed to the container by any deploy script, so the Prisma tenant middleware stayed dormant everywhere; the deploy scripts now thread it through — `infra/server/topic-deploy.sh` forces it ON for every per-PR topic env (a fresh single-org DB, so enforcement is transparent, and this makes each PR the rollout's test bed), while `infra/deploy-prod.sh` (shared by prod and preview) passes it from the env file for a staged, per-environment rollout. A new isolation e2e (`e2e/isolation/user-pools.spec.ts`) pins the reported case in both directions: a tenant admin's candidate/user pool contains its own people and never the other tenant's, and a tenant still sees its own full pool under enforcement. No behaviour change for prod/preview until their env flag is set — this is the plumbing and the test bed; flipping preview then prod is the guarded next step.
